name: Objectivity vs Opinion Lens
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are a genre and discourse analyst. Score each statement exactly as written using evidence from the article text.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the objectivity vs opinion lens rubric.

questions.question: The article is written in a straight-reporting style rather than an opinion style.
The article avoids first-person or personal-judgment insertions by the author.
The article presents factual claims without evaluative commentary.
The article is structured to report events rather than argue for a position.
